reproduced.description: true only when the command fails because of the bug, showing the reported symptom.

command.description: The exact command that fails because of the bug; empty when not reproduced.

output.description: An excerpt of the failing output that shows the symptom (a few lines, secrets as <REDACTED>); empty when not reproduced.

testPath.description: The failing test file you wrote, repository-relative; empty when the command is a script or nothing reproduced.

tried.description: Every attempt that did not reproduce, in order; [] when the first attempt did.

unblock.description: When not reproduced: what would unblock it (access, a redacted artifact, permission for temporary instrumentation).

notes.description: Anything the fixer needs: the seam the test sits at, minimisation left to do.
